title: Bahamas — Key Statistics

population.label: Census population
population.note: Context figure; not a current population estimate.

social.label: Population on New Providence
social.note: Nearly three in four residents live on one island. New Providence: 296,732 people out of 398,165 nationally.

social.label: Internet access and the age gap
social.note: Access among people aged 65+ was 80.4%. The national figure was 64.7% in 2010. These are people with access, not households or broadband subscriptions.

social.label: Adult obesity
social.source: Ministry of Health & Wellness — Bahamas STEPS 2019
social.note: Measured BMI of at least 30 kg/m². National survey estimate; 95% confidence interval 39.9–47.4%. The survey year is 2019.

economic.label: Tourism demand concentrated in the US
economic.period: 2025 · stopover visitors by country of residence
economic.note: US residents made up 1,532,422 of 1,838,168 stopover visitors. This measures market concentration, not tourism’s contribution to GDP. Figures are subject to revision.

economic.label: Goods imports versus exports
economic.source: BNSI — Foreign Trade Statistics Annual Report 2025
economic.note: Imports divided by exports, including re-exports. Services such as tourism are outside this comparison. Imports are c.i.f.; exports f.o.b.
economic.source_location: Table 2.1, printed p. 32; highlights p. viii

economic.label: Food and live-animal imports
economic.source: BNSI — Foreign Trade Statistics Annual Report 2025
economic.note: 16.8% of merchandise imports. This is an import bill, not the share of food consumed that is imported; it does not separate resident and visitor demand.

economic.label: Fuel and related imports
economic.period: 2025 · mineral fuels, lubricants and related materials
economic.source: BNSI — Foreign Trade Statistics Annual Report 2025
economic.note: 10.7% of merchandise imports. Covers fuel and related products for multiple uses; it is not an electricity-generation share or an emissions measure.

economic.label: Central government debt relative to GDP
economic.source: Ministry of Finance — Debt Management Office
economic.note: Central government debt was estimated at B$12.4661bn. The ratio excludes the additional debt of agencies and government business enterprises.

environment.label: Hurricane Dorian: total cost
environment.note: Estimated total: US$2.5bn in direct damage plus US$0.9bn in indirect losses and emergency-response costs. A historical disaster impact, not an annual cost.
environment.source_location: Seven years after Dorian, total-cost paragraph

environment.label: Marine protected areas
environment.source: Office of the Prime Minister — parliamentary statement
environment.note: Area reported as established marine protected areas. Designation alone does not demonstrate effective management or healthy ecosystem condition.
environment.source_location: 8 October 2025 statement on Protected Area Fund Amendment Bill

exclusions: Low-elevation land share: the 2025 NDC uses conflicting elevation thresholds; not used.
Generic tourism GDP shares: not substituted for a verified, defined national tourism-account result.
Electricity projections and capacity targets: not presented as observed generation shares.
